title: Single-condition neural solvers encode transferable response spaces for parametric differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2609.15432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operator learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) typically builds global models over prescribed domains, requiring cross-condition data or costly physics-constrained training. Here we show that the output Jacobian of a neural solution model trained at one condition defines a reusable response space for cross-condition solution variations. We introduce Linearized Subspace Transfer (LST) to exploit this space and recover target solutions by minimizing the target PDE-system residual over response-space coordinates. Because any single response space has finite coverage, Active Transfer Modeling (ATM) uses post-transfer residuals as coverage indicators to selectively acquire response spaces from additional single-condition models. Across six systems, single-condition response spaces supported cross-condition transfer, with enrichment improving accuracy when added spaces expanded representation capacity. Relative to evalu

translated_title: 单条件神经求解器编码参数化微分方程的可迁移响应空间
translated_abstract: 参数化偏微分方程（PDE）的算子学习通常在预定域上构建全局模型，这需要跨条件数据或代价高昂的物理约束训练。在这里，我们证明了在单一条件下训练的神经求解模型的输出雅可比矩阵定义了一个可复用的响应空间，可用于跨条件的解变化。我们引入线性化子空间迁移（LST）方法来利用这一空间，通过在响应空间坐标上最小化目标PDE系统残差来恢复目标解。由于任何单一响应空间的覆盖范围都是有限的，主动迁移建模（ATM）使用迁移后的残差作为覆盖指标，从额外的单条件模型中有选择地获取响应空间。在六个系统中，单条件响应空间支持了跨条件迁移，并且当新增空间扩展了表示能力时，空间富集提高了精度。相对于评估……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用单条件训练的神经求解器输出雅可比矩阵所定义的响应空间，通过线性化子空间迁移（LST）和主动迁移建模（ATM）实现参数化偏微分方程的跨条件解迁移，无需跨条件数据或昂贵的物理约束训练。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the output Jacobian of a neural solver trained at a single condition defines a reusable response space, and proposes Linearized Subspace Transfer (LST) with Active Transfer Modeling (ATM) to achieve cross-condition solution transfer for parametric PDEs without requiring cross-condition data or costly physics-constrained training.
